Programme.ProgrammeName: Maxis Mission AI — Complete UAT Board

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Create a clear team signal using your country greeting. Capture one private team photo and submit a one-sentence explanation.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the private photo shows a safe group signal and the written explanation is present.
Missions.SafetyNote: Use a clear public area. Do not block walkways, entrances, queues or other guests.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Complete the attraction challenge with at least 80% of your current team. Your Captain records the official queue-entry and configured post-ride evidence.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Verify the configured ride pathway, rider count and official queue-entry/post-ride evidence. Exterior-only evidence is not enough.
Missions.SafetyNote: Follow attraction staff instructions. Never use a phone where park rules prohibit it, obstruct a queue, or pressure anyone to ride.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Build a still, human-and-machine team pose. Capture one private photo and write a short caption that names one strength your team brings.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the private photo and caption show the requested team collaboration.
Missions.SafetyNote: Use a safe public area. Do not climb, enter restricted areas, or interfere with guests or staff.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Find a safe public spot in Moonhaven. Capture one private team photo and submit a concise message describing how your team will stay connected during the hunt.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the safe-location photo and connection message are present.
Missions.SafetyNote: Stay in public guest areas and keep clear of attraction entrances and walkways.

Missions.LocationDescription: Any safe Studio Plaza public area
Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Agree your next two mission choices. Submit the number of choices you have agreed (1 or 2) and a one-sentence reason for the order.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve 1 or 2 only when the written reason explains a realistic team plan.
Missions.SafetyNote: Plan without blocking queues or walkways.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Your team chooses a safe location for a private group photo. Submit one sentence explaining how every person contributed to a decision.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the photo and inclusion explanation are present. This visible Secret Mission is available from the start.
Missions.SafetyNote: Keep the mission private, safe and respectful. Do not block paths or involve other guests without consent.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Create a short team momentum check-in. Submit the number of team members who contributed a next-step idea and a one-sentence summary of the best idea.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the numeric count is within the current team size and the summary is specific.
Missions.SafetyNote: Keep moving safely and do not stop in a queue, entrance or ride exit.

Missions.ParticipantInstruction: Create a final country-greeting team signal. Capture one private photo and submit a short message your team would share with another country team.
Missions.FacilitatorInstruction: Approve when the photo and respectful country-to-country message are present.
Missions.SafetyNote: Keep clear of walkways and queues. Do not photograph guests without consent.
